design_gotchas.title: Strict 0.3–22 Ohm ESR Window — Unstable With Direct MLCC Ceramic Output Capacitors
design_gotchas.detail: Section 9.2.2.1.1 (p.15) mandates at least 10 uF tantalum with ESR strictly between 0.3 ohm and 22 ohm. Placing an MLCC directly on VOUT without a ~0.5–1 ohm series resistor causes oscillation. If your BOM requires MLCC-only stability on the same SOT-223 1117 footprint, evaluate ceramic-stable candidates like AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 or new-chip TLV1117.

design_gotchas.title: Industrial LM1117I Grade Widens Over-Temperature Accuracy to ±4% & IQ Max to 15 mA
design_gotchas.detail: Whereas commercial LM1117 (0–125°C, Sec 7.5) holds ±2% over temperature and 10 mA max IQ, the industrial LM1117I-3.3 (-40 to +125°C, Sec 7.6, p.7-8) allows ±4% VOUT tolerance (3.168–3.432 V), 15 mA max IQ, and 1.4 V max dropout at 800 mA. Always read Section 7.6 for IMP/IMPX OPNs.

design_gotchas.title: SOT-223 Tab is VOUT (Not GND) & Real-World RθJA Reaches 136°C/W on Minimal Pad
design_gotchas.detail: Pin 4 (tab) is internally connected to VOUT (Pin 2, p.3), making it incompatible with GND-tab SOT-223 regulators like LM2937 or AP7361C-33E-13. While JEDEC high-K RθJA is 61.6°C/W (p.4), Table 9-2 (p.18) demonstrates 136°C/W on a minimal 0.0123 in² pad—provide >= 0.4 in² copper on VOUT for sustained 5 V->3.3 V @ 800 mA.

design_gotchas.title: High Output Capacitance (>= 1000 uF) Needs External Reverse-Discharge Protection Diode
design_gotchas.detail: Section 8.4.1 (p.13) notes the internal output-to-input diode handles 10–20 A microsecond surges, but when COUT >= 1000 uF and VIN is abruptly shorted to ground, an external Schottky diode from VOUT to VIN is recommended to prevent silicon damage.

typical_use_cases: Industrial -40°C to +125°C 5 V or 12 V bus post-regulation to 3.3 V up to 800 mA
Higher-VIN-margin (20 V abs max) candidate drop-in replacement for AMS1117-3.3 footprints using tantalum COUT
Active SCSI/fieldbus termination and robust legacy 3.3 V linear supplies
High-PSRR (75 dB at 120 Hz) linear post-regulator downstream of a 5 V switching buck converter
engineering_summary: The TI LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB is an industrial-grade (-40°C to +125°C) 800 mA SOT-223-3 (DCY) LDO with standard 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN) and 20 V absolute maximum input voltage. It is a widely used candidate drop-in for AMS1117-3.3 and NCP1117ST33T3G footprints, offering wider -40°C rating and higher VIN margin than AMS1117, but engineers must verify its strict 0.3–22 ohm ESR window (not ceramic-stable), ±4% over-temp tolerance, 1.4 V max dropout, and VOUT tab copper heatsinking before production.
